title: One Who Performs Selfless Service, Without Thought
summary: Seva is being answered in the middle of pressure, not after the day has calmed down.
takeaway: He is not to call attention to himself in any way; one who performs selfless service, without thought of reward,
lifeApplication: Do one hidden act of service that does not return to self-advertisement. Use the line before the pressure chooses your tone.

source.shortMeaning: He is not to call attention to himself in any way; one who performs selfless service, without thought of reward,
source.lifeApplication: Let the wider line hold together what the mind wants to split apart.

evidence.turn: Seva becomes transformative when the self stops trying to be seen through it.
